apis.name: Alpha Vantage
apis.description: Stock market, forex and cryptocurrency data API with historical and intraday time series, technical indicators and fundamental data. Free API key tier available.

apis.name: CoinGecko
apis.description: Cryptocurrency market data API: prices, market caps, historical charts, exchanges and trending coins across thousands of assets. Free public tier available.
features: Prices and market data for 10,000+ coins

apis.name: Frankfurter
apis.description: Exchange rates API published by the European Central Bank. Converts between 30+ world currencies with historical rates back to 1999. No API key required.
features: Latest and historical ECB reference rates

apis.name: Free Dictionary API
apis.description: Simple, fast dictionary API returning definitions, phonetics, audio pronunciations, synonyms and antonyms for English words. No authentication required.
features: Word definitions with parts of speech

apis.name: GitHub REST API
apis.description: Official REST interface to GitHub data: repositories, issues, pull requests, users, commits, and more. Unauthenticated requests are limited; authenticated requests get a much higher rate limit.
features: Full read/write access to repository data
Issues, pull requests, and commit history

apis.name: Hacker News API
apis.description: Official, read-only Firebase-backed API for Hacker News: top, new and best stories, comments, users and full item trees. Unauthenticated and free.
features: Top, new, best and ask/show story feeds
Full comment trees for every item

apis.name: ipify
apis.description: Simple public IP address API that returns the caller's IPv4 or IPv6 address in plain text, JSON or JSONP. Handles billions of requests daily with no limits.
features: Plain text, JSON and JSONP output

apis.name: Nager.Date
apis.description: Worldwide public holiday API covering 100+ countries: national holidays, long weekends, and next-upcoming holidays. Free and unauthenticated.

apis.name: NASA APIs
apis.description: Official NASA data APIs: Astronomy Picture of the Day, Mars rover photos, Earth imagery, near-Earth objects, EPIC satellite images and more. Free API key available instantly.
features: Instant free API key by email

apis.name: Open-Meteo
apis.description: Global weather forecast and historical weather data API for non-commercial use. Offers hourly and daily forecasts, air quality, and geocoding without requiring an API key.
features: Hourly and daily weather forecasts up to 16 days

apis.name: PokeAPI
apis.description: Comprehensive RESTful API for Pokemon data: species, abilities, moves, types, items and game information. Free and open with no authentication.
features: Full Pokemon species and stat data

apis.name: REST Countries
apis.description: Free API providing information about world countries: names, capitals, populations, currencies, languages, flags, timezones and borders. No authentication required.
features: Country profiles with capital, region and population
Flag images in SVG and PNG

apis.name: TheDogAPI
apis.description: Dog pictures and breed information API: thousands of curated images with temperament, life span, origin and weight data for hundreds of breeds. Free tier with optional key.
features: Favourites and voting on free tier
Works without a key for basic use

apis.name: TheSpaceDevs (Launch Library 2)
apis.description: Comprehensive spaceflight API covering upcoming rocket launches, spaceflight events, astronauts, space stations and spacecraft. Free tier available with rate limits.
features: Upcoming and past rocket launch schedules
Launch provider, rocket and pad details
